domain_note: Authenticated bytes are the ASCII domain, one NUL byte, then the canonical payload with signature or mac removed.
authenticator_note: Cases marked authenticator=valid must pass cryptographic verification so the semantic rule under test is actually reached. Cases marked invalid fail verification itself.
warning: Seeds below are published test values and must never sign anything real.
why_this_file_exists: Cross-purpose refusal cannot be exercised by a wire artifact. key_id is derived from the custody secret, so an acknowledgement whose key_id is held under another purpose is byte-identical to a valid one -- the defect is entirely in receiver state. Emitting it beside the valid case in custody-acknowledgement.json would produce a rejection indistinguishable from the acceptance, which this contract forbids. What is tested here is stored state plus one conforming artifact.

cases.name: key_id_held_for_another_purpose
cases.note: The acknowledgement is fully conforming and its MAC recomputes. The registry holds this key_id under evidence_device rather than gateway_custody, and purpose separation is enforced at selection, so it MUST NOT be accepted however well it verifies.

receiver_state.gateway_custody_registry: holds no generation deriving to this key_id
